description: Header file defining the 'Service' class within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, including nested 'Config' class, with methods for configuration, state management, web server setup, and notification handling.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service with configuration, state management, web server hosting, and notification capabilities within the Thunder plugin framework.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Nested class within Service that manages plugin configuration parameters such as paths, start mode, and web prefix.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the locator string from the plugin configuration.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name from the plugin configuration.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign string from the plugin configuration.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix URL for the service.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Gets or sets the configuration line string.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Gets or sets the system root path.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the service.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Checks or sets whether the service is resumed.

methods.name: ErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the current error message, if any.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Fills metadata information about the service.

methods.name: IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request segment is for the web server.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes inbound requests, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a channel for notifications.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a channel from notifications.

methods.name: EnableWebServer
methods.description: Configures the web server with URL postfix and root path.

methods.name: DisableWebServer
methods.description: Disables the web server hosting.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Returns the plugin configuration object.

methods.name: StartupOrder
methods.description: Returns the startup order priority.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the service is active.

methods.name: IsHibernated
methods.description: Checks if the service is hibernated.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if there is an error message.

methods.name: ErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the current error message.

methods.name: FileToServe
methods.description: Serves a file for web requests.
